newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel destroys Palestinian suspect's home.
newsitem.headline: Israel destroys Palestinian suspect's home.

text.p: Israel destroyed the West Bank home of a Palestinian suspected of belonging to an Islamic militant group accused of killing 11 Israelis since 1996, the army said on Wednesday.
Palestinian sources said Sourif village near Hebron, where the demolition occurred, remained quiet since most villagers were asleep when the army destroyed the house.
"The army destroyed the house of the terrorist...Jamal al-Hoor," the army said in a statement.
Palestinian sources said the house was owned by Hoor's father-in-law. Palestinians and human rights groups condemn Israel's practice of demolishing homes as collective punishment.
Except for a three-day break, Sourif has been under curfew since a resident killed himself and three Israeli women in a bombing at a Tel Aviv cafe on March 21.
It was the third home destroyed at Sourif since Israel and the Palestinian Authority arrested five members of a cell of the Islamic Resistance Movement Hamas based at Sourif earlier this month.
The sixth member of the cell was the Tel Aviv bomber.

Sourif is in a part of the West Bank still under Israeli control after Israel transferred eight towns, including 80 percent of Hebron, to Palestinian self-rule under deals stemming from a 1993 framework peace accord.
